items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Well, them, a lot of them don't like to say Sachmark. We started that down here, Sachmark.

ctx.x: I call him Sach. What did people say? Because some people say Lewis, some people say Louis.
Well, them, a lot of them don't like to say Sachmark. We started that down here, Sachmark.
